claim_text: Mystery Babylon about to be judged and Iraq rising from the ashes, with green palm trees flourishing, vast oil wealth and mega buildings and skyscrapers going up like those in Saudi Arabia.
quote: Iraq is about to rise from the ashes
falsify_match: A construction and oil boom in Iraq comparable to the Gulf states.
falsify_miss: Iraq stays constrained by militia politics and oil dependence. He compares it to the Saudi tower project, which sets a visible benchmark.

claim_text: A complete infrastructure change in Iraq with the economy rising to the world stage alongside Saudi Arabia, under new leaders who get rid of the corruption tied to Iran.
quote: a complete infrastructure change
falsify_match: An Iraqi government that visibly breaks Iranian influence and delivers a construction programme.
falsify_miss: Iranian-aligned blocs keep their position in Baghdad. The corruption tied to Iran is the specific and checkable half.

claim_text: Wealth distributed to Iraqi citizens rather than poverty, on the pattern of people driving Lamborghinis in Saudi Arabia, with big money coming out of Iraq and deals struck bringing stabilisation, while Iran stays in the background wounded and cantankerous.
quote: a distribution of wealth to the citizens, to the people
falsify_match: Iraqi per capita income rising toward Gulf levels.
falsify_miss: Iraqi incomes stay near their current level. He asks himself how it could happen and does not answer, which he notes.

claim_text: Told again to watch the Middle East with Israel at the forefront, peace agreements, the third temple and great oil wealth out of the Mediterranean, because it started there and it will end there.
quote: it started there and it will end there
falsify_match: A regional settlement including a temple provision and Mediterranean energy development.
falsify_miss: No settlement of that kind. Watch the Middle East is the least falsifiable instruction in the corpus, since something always happens there.

claim_text: He repeats that it started in the garden and will end there, and says the days ahead are bright for the body of Christ and for the remnant.
quote: it started there in the garden and it will end there
falsify_match: Not checkable; a scriptural framing.
falsify_miss: Not checkable, and it is offered as the reason for watching rather than as an event.

claim_text: He says he saw the Canadian election result several weeks earlier and chose not to say it so as not to discourage believers, and that in the previous day's prayer he saw Canadians weeping over the turnout and an uprising in the Christian community.
quote: I saw this coming several weeks ago, but I did not want to come out
falsify_match: A recording before 28 April 2025 naming the Liberal win.
falsify_miss: No such recording exists, since he says he withheld it. The crying he points to is in a prayer video from the day before the result, which he offers as the evidence.

claim_text: Little fires in Queensland with people rising against their government in Australia, whiskey barrels rolling down from Canada into America over the trade, and a depression hitting Canada's economy similar to America.
quote: I saw little fires in Queensland, Australia
falsify_match: Civil disorder in Queensland and a Canadian depression.
falsify_miss: Neither. Little fires rather than big ones is his own qualification, which lowers what would count.

claim_text: British Columbia wanting to stand out on its own because it wants to be part of the digital platform, with the timing unknown, and a major revival in Canada coming out of great pressure.
quote: British cor Colombia wanted to stand out on their own
falsify_match: A British Columbian separation movement tied to digital currency.
falsify_miss: No such movement. The motive given here is the digital platform, which is different from the earthquake motive he gives later.

claim_text: He blames the political result on preachers in Canada without a backbone who are not preaching an uncompromising word, saying that as the church goes so does everything else, and recalls being shown lukewarmness in the churches.
quote: the preachers not having a backbone in Canada
falsify_match: Not checkable as an event; a causal claim about why the culture is as it is.
falsify_miss: Not checkable. Recorded because it is the standing explanation he gives for political outcomes he does not like.

claim_text: Sticky oily honey coming off the preachers' mouths with cockroaches crawling in and out and resting on their lips, and babies in diapers across the land, because the preachers are giving a milk gospel rather than the meat of the word.
quote: cockroaches were coming in and out of the mouth
falsify_match: Not checkable as an event; an image of the state of preaching.
falsify_miss: Not checkable. The honey and cockroaches recur across tellings, which makes the image stable even though it cannot fail.

claim_text: The babies in diapers seen not only across America but across the whole world, described as a global problem of a compromising lukewarm gospel, with people needing a backbone like a crowbar because what is coming will shake the world.
quote: a backbone like a crowbar
falsify_match: Not checkable as an event.
falsify_miss: Not checkable.

claim_text: A communist party trying to rise in South Korea as bad as North Korea's, coming gradually like a frog in a pot as the Chinese communist party works through North Korea, with China trying to draw in South Korea and Taiwan like a mother hen gathering chicks.
quote: a communist party trying to rise up in Korea
falsify_match: A pro-Chinese or communist government taking power in Seoul.
falsify_miss: South Korea holds free elections and stays aligned with America. The June 2025 election returned a liberal rather than a communist government, which is the nearest test.

claim_text: The window is real but conditional on who will pray, since the wealth transfer will not simply happen, with a wrecking ball swinging and intercession like Abraham's needed to hold it back.
quote: the window is based on who will pray
falsify_match: A wealth transfer arriving.
falsify_miss: None arrives, which under this framing is attributed to insufficient prayer rather than to the word.

claim_text: Shortages of food, goods, car parts and computer chips, and major power outages from Chinese cyber attacks leaving some cities without electricity for three weeks, mainly on the east coast, which he says he warned of the previous July.
quote: people without electricity in some cities for three weeks
falsify_match: An American city losing power for three weeks after a cyber attack.
falsify_miss: No outage of that length from an attack. Three weeks is a hard number and the longest American blackouts from any cause have been storm-related.

claim_text: Russia offering North Korea entry into BRICS to get out from under western sanctions, and adversaries laughing at Trump behind closed doors and refusing to be dominated, while making alliances with Cuba and Venezuela.
quote: I saw them laughing at Trump. I saw them laughing
falsify_match: North Korea, Cuba or Venezuela formally joining BRICS.
falsify_miss: None joins. He says he has not made much of this public, which is the same withholding pattern.

claim_text: Jesus standing above America asking who will stand in the gap, a massive python coming up out of the Gulf of Mexico and wrapping around America to squeeze it from within, and storms of communism, war and antichrist spirit trying to come too fast while the Lord wants more time.
quote: a massive python coming up out of the Gulf of Mexico
falsify_match: Not checkable as an event; an emblem of pressure on America.
falsify_miss: Not checkable. The more time framing means any delay is attributed to prayer.

claim_text: Prayer for the church to rise in Canada, South Korea and Australia and for America not to squander the reprieve, invoking the Tommy Hicks vision of the giant pointing toward the body of Christ.
quote: just like the Tommy Hicks vision
falsify_match: Not applicable; a petition.
falsify_miss: Not applicable, though the Tommy Hicks vision from 1961 is the older prophecy he places himself downstream of.

claim_text: A character read on the president as a bulldozer who will not accept being the one who took America down, trying to salvage a country thirty six trillion dollars in the hole, with the ship described as sinking and no ifs or buts about it.
quote: The ship is sinking, folks
falsify_match: A sovereign debt crisis in America.
falsify_miss: Debt service stays manageable. The Titanic image recurs across the corpus and the debt figure he uses is the published one.

claim_text: He asks what people will do with the extra time given, says he will put his tap root down into the living water, and explains he is playing a prayer recorded two or three days earlier that he did not feel peace about releasing at the time.
quote: I didn't feel peace about releasing that video
falsify_match: Not applicable; an account of his process.
falsify_miss: Not applicable, though holding a recording back and releasing it later is worth noting for any priority question.

claim_text: A fragment identifying the dragon in the vision as representing the Chinese.
quote: The dragon represents the Chinese
falsify_match: Not applicable; an identification of an image.
falsify_miss: Not applicable.

claim_text: A depression over China brought on by pride in the tariff wars, which lifts the iron curtain there so that a mighty wave comes through an open door, with an uprising following in China and in Canada over the economy and the government.
quote: a depression causes the iron curtain to be lifted
falsify_match: A Chinese economic contraction followed by a relaxation of religious restriction.
falsify_miss: Chinese restrictions tighten regardless of economic conditions, which is what happened after 2018. The causal link is the checkable part.

claim_text: The uprising described as people fed up and demanding change, like lynch mobs with pitchforks and torches, over decisions that have been made.
quote: people that are fit like lynch mobs
falsify_match: Violent public disorder over economic decisions in Canada or China.
falsify_miss: Protests stay within normal bounds. Pitchforks and torches is imagery rather than a described event.

claim_text: The Sooners named again as South Korea and Japan, and British Columbia as another Sooner that will try to break off as things crumble, with a red highway running through it all the way to Alaska.
quote: South Korea and Japan are the sinners
falsify_match: South Korea and Japan moving first on something America follows, and a BC separation with an Alaska road link.
falsify_miss: Neither. The Sooners framing was later attached to crypto legislation, and here it is attached to secession, which is a different use of the same word.

claim_text: The very thing they are trying to manipulate will be their demise, with uprisings in China, across Asia, and in Australia with Queensland named, and a line running from a city clear into Russia.
quote: The very thing they try to manipulate will be their demise
falsify_match: A Chinese policy backfiring visibly and producing domestic unrest.
falsify_miss: No such unrest. The formula that the thing they manipulate becomes their demise fits any outcome after the fact.

claim_text: Fires and China getting desperate out of pride, with a focus on the upper portion of China toward Russia, then Rome and Italy shown.
quote: China's getting desperate out of pride
falsify_match: A crisis in northern China near the Russian border.
falsify_miss: Nothing occurs there. Rome and Italy are named without content, as they are in several sessions.

claim_text: The restraint on the Spirit in China lifting like a curtain pulled back that can be walked through for a short season, brought on by stiff-necked pride like Pharaoh's, so that liberation comes out of the hardening.
quote: That window was open for a a a season
falsify_match: A period of religious opening in China followed by re-closure.
falsify_miss: No opening. The Pharaoh framing means hardening is expected first, so worsening conditions confirm the claim rather than refuting it.

claim_text: As the children of Israel left Egypt with the gold and silver and no feeble one among them, so the bride will have no feeble ones, with church services in which no sick people are present and all are healed.
quote: there'll be church services that no sick people will be in there
falsify_match: A documented service in which every ill person present was healed.
falsify_miss: No such service is documented. This is the earliest telling on file, seven weeks before the June version.

claim_text: He says a news article about Iran beefing up security around a mountain matches the vision he was given of an underground city in a mountain holding biological weapons and military secrets, with the satellite diagrams identical to what he saw.
quote: It's identical. You can see all the little diagrams
falsify_match: A recording of the vision predating the article, with details that match.
falsify_miss: The vision postdates the reporting, or the match is generic. Iranian underground facilities at Fordow and Natanz had been photographed and mapped publicly for years.

claim_text: Trucks carrying orange mustard gas in fifty gallon drums, small trucks with tarps rather than semis, travelling a road around the mountain up through the top of Iraq and on into Syria, with the biological material ending up in Damascus.
quote: trucks carrying orange gas, orange mustard, 50-gallon drums
falsify_match: Chemical material moved by road from Iran through Iraq to Damascus.
falsify_miss: No such movement is established. This is the earliest and most detailed telling of the fifty gallon drums on file, two months before the June version.

claim_text: He reads aloud another man's dream, a violinist he says he does not know, of a huge angel in golden armour standing over New York Harbour above the Statue of Liberty, drawing a hundred foot sword and poised to cleave the statue in two.
quote: I saw a huge angel standing suspended in the air
falsify_match: Not applicable; another person's dream being read out.
falsify_miss: Not applicable. A dream he reads is not a claim he makes, and it is recorded here to show what he treats as corroboration.

claim_text: The read dream continues with the angel declaring America weighed in the balances and found wanting, fallen lower than Sodom and prouder than Babylon, with the bowls of wrath full and about to be poured out.
quote: You have been weighed in the balances of God and found wanting
falsify_match: Not applicable; another person's dream.
falsify_miss: Not applicable.

claim_text: The read dream describes America cracking down the middle in a giant earthquake, the southeast covered by a wave and the west coast cities falling into the Pacific from Mexico to Alaska, and he interjects that this is what he himself saw and told viewers.
quote: Do you remember that? I told you all I saw this
falsify_match: A continental split and west coast subsidence.
falsify_miss: No such event, and no mechanism exists for the west coast to fall into the ocean. What is recorded here is his claim that his own vision matched another man's dream, which is the corroboration pattern rather than a new claim.

claim_text: The read dream continues with three nuclear missiles, two from the ocean and one from land, detonating in the upper atmosphere within five minutes of each other, the largest making a mushroom cloud over the Midwest, after which everything goes black.
quote: three giant rocket missiles that took off into the air
falsify_match: Not applicable; another person's dream.
falsify_miss: Not applicable, though the high altitude detonation pattern matches the EMP material he gives in his own name elsewhere.

claim_text: The read dream ends with revival among survivors and then tribulation kiosks in every town offering food and water only to those who take an electronic mark, bowing to holographic images of the antichrist and coming out with a zombie look, which he says matches what he told viewers.
quote: Remember I told you it was zombies
falsify_match: Not applicable; another person's dream.
falsify_miss: Not applicable, though he claims the zombie detail as his own too.

claim_text: He says the videos are placed strategically because people forget, that what is coming is a shaking to awaken, and that many will call it an Ichabod and think the glory has departed when it is not.
quote: many of you all will call it a great kabad
falsify_match: Not applicable; a framing.
falsify_miss: Not applicable, though it pre-empts the reading that hardship means the words were not from God.

claim_text: He says intercessory prayer has delayed the judgment but there is coming a point when the prayers of the saints will not be able to hold back what is about to take place, and points to retailers warning of empty shelves by the summer if the trade wars do not end.
quote: the prayers of the saints will not be able to hold back
falsify_match: Empty shelves at the major American retailers by summer 2025.
falsify_miss: Shelves stayed stocked through summer 2025. The prayer-delays-it structure means no non-event can count against the underlying claim, which is why this passage matters.

claim_text: He states that the plague will take place during Trump's presidency, that he has had two dreams warning of a plague of 350 million, and that he prays it is delayed.
quote: I've told you the plague will take place during Trump's presidency
falsify_match: A pandemic killing on that order before January 2029.
falsify_miss: No pandemic in that window. This is one of the few places he attaches the plague to a bounded period, which makes it scoreable in January 2029.

claim_text: The 350 million said to be just in this area, from Canada down, with the Lord telling him it is a lot bigger and worse than people realise and that people are not taking it seriously.
quote: a major plague of 350 million people uh just in this area
falsify_match: Deaths of that magnitude in North America.
falsify_miss: No such toll. Just in this area is a tightening: North America holds about 500 million people, so this is a majority of the continent.

claim_text: The babies in diapers from sea to shining sea recalled again with the honey on the preachers' lips, because the body of Christ was not being taught to have a backbone.
quote: There was babies upon the land
falsify_match: Not checkable as an event.
falsify_miss: Not checkable.

claim_text: He is told that money is America's god and that God is about to touch the money, which he says he does not know how will take place, with a window given for those who are listening.
quote: you told me I'm about to touch the money
falsify_match: A monetary or currency shock in America.
falsify_miss: No shock. Touch the money is broad enough that inflation, a market fall or a banking event would all fit.

claim_text: Prayer that the Canadian vote not be hindered or manipulated by computers or men so that the true heart of the country is shown, and the same for the South Korean election, where he prays they stay free rather than going communist.
quote: the true vote of the heart of Canada will be shown
falsify_match: Not applicable; a petition given the day before the Canadian vote.
falsify_miss: Not applicable, though the result he then treats as a defeat is the one this prayer asks to be shown truly.

claim_text: A dragon over South Korea trying to pull it into communism and gobble up Taiwan, with prayer that the trade war cease abruptly and that China and America get along for the season, which he says leads to the end time beast system.
quote: a dragon that would try to pull them into communism
falsify_match: South Korea moving toward Chinese alignment.
falsify_miss: It stays in the American alliance. He prays for the trade war to end while saying the resulting cooperation leads to the beast system, which makes both outcomes negative.

claim_text: A closing fragment of the same prayer over the window to save the lost.
quote: lost, to reach out and to touch the people
falsify_match: Not applicable.
falsify_miss: Not applicable.

claim_text: Alliances between Putin and Cuba around Havana growing stronger, terrorists coming up out of underground like tens of thousands of ants, and the 350 million plague being pushed back so that it becomes something like a ten percent version rather than hundreds of millions perishing.
quote: I feel we're pushing it
falsify_match: A pandemic at either scale.
falsify_miss: No pandemic. The ten percent version is a rare instance of him naming a reduced outcome in advance, which means a smaller event could later be claimed as the prayed-down form.

claim_text: Millions of people coming to the I-35 corridor down to Fort Worth soon because they are fleeing what is going to happen on the east coast and the west coast, with a wealthy man having bought and renovated a property there because he was told about the revival.
quote: millions of people come here soon because they're fleeing
falsify_match: Migration in the millions from both coasts into the central corridor.
falsify_miss: Migration stays at ordinary rates. Texas already leads the country in net domestic in-migration, so only an unusual surge would count.
